answer: Stake sits frozen like a glacier until work earns gradual release, so each forged identity must first lock real capital. The kernel of defense is delay: an identity that ages one ledger epoch costs nothing to describe but everything to duplicate a thousand times. Attackers therefore lean on the ledge of early stake, and every clone has to pay the same frozen toll up front. Bottleneck: capital immobilized per identity, not cleverness, sets the ceiling on sybils.
